name: 泥潭6
group_note: NT/nitan lineage but not byte-identical to nitan170911/nitan6. Prior WASM pass ported the §7.15 dbase-architecture fix comment/wizard.lpc pieces from nitan170911 and fixed several other bugs (GBK is_chinese(), origin() checks, band.lpc loopback, NTOS heartbeat removal, mudlistd.lpc sockets/array-type bugs) and got the lib to boot-clean, but left interactive registration unverified due to this lib's slow distributed preload (SYSTEM_D->valid_login() gates on a preload_list that drains one file per real second via call_out, ~30s total) repeatedly hitting test-harness timing issues. THIS pass finally completed registration verification and found the real remaining blockers were architectural, not timing: (1) the §7.15 port was incomplete -- feature/dbase.lpc's own comment already claimed set()/query()/delete() were 'now defined' as real per-object functions, but the actual function BODIES were never copied from nitan170911, so every F_DBASE-inheriting object's bare set()/query() calls still silently hit the simul_efun's single SHARED fallback dbase instead of their own -- ported the complete implementation (set/query/delete/set_temp/query_temp/delete_temp) from nitan170911's feature/dbase.lpc, this time verified against the actual file, not just the comment. (2) A second §8.1-class GBK byte-count-not-halved bug survived in logind.lpc's get_surname()/get_name() (check_legal_name(arg, 4) should be 2, matching the 'no more than 2 hanzi' prompt) and named.lpc's invalid_new_name() (strlen(name) < 2 should be < 1 -- rejected every legitimate single-character given name, e.g. '风', as 'empty name'). (3) 5 files (user.lpc, baby.lpc, giftd.lpc, examined.lpc, room.lpc) used `efun::set/query/addn/delete(...)` inside local property-accessor overrides to call the 'real' implementation, bypassing their own override -- but set/query/etc. were never genuine driver efuns on this build (only simul_efuns/inherited functions), so `efun::` failed to resolve at all ('Unknown efun'). Fixed by switching to `::` (parent-scope, resolves through F_DBASE now that it's complete) for set/query/delete, and to a direct `ob->add(prop,data)` call for the `addn` cases specifically (addn is simul_efun-only, never inherited, so `::addn` has no valid target -- two call sites had simply typo'd `addn` where the surrounding function was itself named `add()` and should have called `::add`, matching F_DBASE's real add()). Confirmed via a live WASM registration: full id->confirm->surname->name->admin-password->confirm->login-password->confirm->gender->email-registration flow completes with zero compile errors, look/quit verified (quit's new-account 30-min-retention deletion-confirmation flow also verified). A wizlist-listed admin id ('fluffos') was re-registered fresh and correctly routed to the wizard-only start room (巫师休息室), confirming admin status is honored. 'score' returns a 还没有出生呐 ('not yet born') refusal for a freshly registered character -- NOT a bug: this lib has a separate in-universe 'birth ritual' (talking to creation-myth NPCs like pangu/dizangwang in /d/register/) that a real player completes before the born flag is set; out of scope for this pass same as any other content/game-design gating. Existing formatter pass (prior commit) covers the whole lib; the ~8 files touched this pass were re-run through the formatter individually and needed no changes (already matched its style).
